name: Edit Permissions by Default
description: Changes the default entity operation on roles to be "edit permissions" instead of just "edit".
project_description: When editing roles the default operation is normally "edit", which only lets you change the label or machine name of a role. In most cases an administrator on the roles list actually wants to edit the permissions of a role rather than rename it. This module reweights the role's "Edit permissions" operation so it sorts ahead of "Edit" and becomes the primary/default action on the People > Roles admin list. It is a pure admin-UX convenience implemented with a single hook_entity_operation_alter() and grants no new access.
